A very disappointing Christmas Dinner
Dec 2025 • Friends
For numerous reasons, Christmas is a very special time of the year for me, which is why I always book a 5-star hotel to celebrate.

In 2025, I celebrated at The Grill restaurant, which was out of this world, but in 2026, Sheraton Grand changed the venue to Table 88. They also have a new General Manager and Executive Chef.

Please see my review below.

Pre-arrival communication:
- For every event I attend at the Sheraton Grand, I always liaise with Phuong Lee. She is friendly, professional and efficient!
- Rating: 5/5

Hotel Arrival:
- Last year, as soon as my taxi arrived, I was greeted by two gentlemen, who kindly opened the door for me, asked where I was going and directed me to the Grill restaurant. This is 5 star service!
- Rating: 5/5
- This year, again, there were two gentlemen, but this time when I arrived, nobody opened my door and I didn’t receive the same friendly greeting as I did last year. This isn’t 5 star service!
- Rating: 3/5

Lobby and Restaurant Decorations:
- Some welcome drinks and canapés were provided, which were nice.
- I’m very happy to say this year the decorations were the same as last year. Festive, Elegant and Classy.
- Rating: 5/5

Restaurant Service:
- Again, I’m happy to say the service I received was exactly the same as last year. Everyone was happy, friendly, professional and attentive. Exceptional! Thank you!
- Rating: 5/5

Atmosphere:
- Last year the live entertainment was Incredible! People were dancing at their tables and outside near the pool and when the brunch was due to finish, myself and other guests didn’t want to leave.
- This year, the entertainment was extremely disappointing. Every table but mine and one other group who were celebrating a birthday was empty before 9pm. This is 90 mins before the event was due to finish. The live music stopped at 9pm. So since there was no live entertainment, no guests and no atmosphere, I also decided to leave early. Honestly, I can’t stress enough how disappointing this was!
- Rating: 2/5

The Food:
- Like last year, the variety of food was excellent, but unfortunately, this year the execution of some dishes just wasn’t good and certainly not what you would expect from a 5-star hotel.
- Beef Wellington: The pastry was soggy and the duxelles didn’t have an earthy, savory, rich taste. As one of the so-called star dishes, it was very disappointing!
- Porchetta: Spicy and too much salt
- Lamb: It wasn’t pink, it was raw.
- Duck: Tough and overcooked.
- Lobster: Not fresh and not good.
- Desserts: Very Disappointing.
- I also noticed other guests left quite a bit of food, so it seems I wasn’t the only guest who wasn’t satisfied with the way some dishes had been cooked.
- On a positive note, the turkey was amazing and the prawns and sushi were fresh and delicious.
- Rating: 2/5 (Again, not what you expect from a 5-star hotel, especially the Sheraton Grand)

How much does Sheraton charge?

- Price per guest: 1,788,000 ++ VND (Food)
- Price per guest: 588,000 ++ VND (Drinks)
- Total: 2,376,000 ++

With taxes and service charge, you’re paying over $100 per person.

Note:
The drinks package included unlimited alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks between 18:00 and 22:30.

- Local Beers
- White, Red and Mulled Wine
- A couple of festive cocktails and mock-tails
- Fresh Juices
- Soft Drinks
- Still water

Summary:
The disappointing food and poor entertainment/atmosphere ruined my Christmas!

Overall Rating: 2/5

Breakfast that satisfied all the families who were very satisfied
Sep 2026 • Family
This is a breakfast buffet where everyone, adults and children, can be satisfied with the menu while staying at the Sheraton for a family trip. There are various Vietnamese dishes such as pho and banh mi, as well as Western and Korean dishes (kimchi, kimchi soup, rice, etc.) on the menu. You can also choose various toppings to put on the cereal and yogurt according to your taste. The variety is diverse, from basic bread to dessert-type bakery items, and the coffee is delicious. Since a Korean staff member is also on-site, quick action is possible if there is a problem.
